article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Braeden Speed had 24 points in Loyola Maryland's 67-62 win against Bucknell on Saturday. Speed added five rebounds for the Greyhounds (7-14, 3-5 Patriot League). Tyson Commander scored nine points while finishing 3 of 4 from 3-point range. Amon Dorries finished with 26 points and seven rebounds for the Bison (6-15, 3-5). Achile Spadone added 18 points, seven rebounds and five steals for Bucknell. Speed put up seven points in the first half for Loyola, which led 31-23 at the break. Speed's 17-point second half helped Loyola close out the five-point victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
